name: swissyphus
display_name: Swissyphus — The AI gateway to Switzerland 🇨🇭
description: Swissyphus — The AI gateway to Switzerland. Zero-key MCP server for Swiss public data: companies, transport, weather, hydrology, geodata, law, statistics, parliament, avalanche, snow, earthquakes, exchange rates, holidays and more. Source attribution on every response.
long_description: One MCP server for ~25 official Swiss open-data sources — companies, transport, weather, hydrology, geodata, law, statistics, parliament, voting, alerts, avalanche, snow, earthquakes, air quality, energy, exchange rates and more. Zero API keys, and every response carries source attribution, licence and freshness metadata. Runs fully locally over stdio.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search the Swiss commercial register (ZEFIX, 700k+ entities) by company name. Returns UID, legal form, seat, status and a link to the cantonal register excerpt. A UID like 'CHE-123.456.789' as query is looked up directly.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Full ZEFIX record for one company: purpose, translations, seat, status, legal form, SOGC date and register links. Identify the company by UID ('CHE-107.028.276' or its 9 digits), exact registered name (case-insensitive; otherwise candidates are returned), or numeric EHRAID.

tools.name: list_legal_forms
tools.description: List the legal-form codes (ZEFIX legalFormId) used in the Swiss commercial register (AG, GmbH, foundation, …).

tools.name: list_cantons
tools.description: All 26 Swiss cantons with their two-letter abbreviations (used as filters across Swissyphus tools).

tools.name: search_sogc_publications
tools.description: Search official Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce (SOGC/SHAB) publications: commercial-register mutations (HR), bankruptcies (KK), debt enforcement, and more. Filter by keyword, rubric and date range. Results are listed newest first.

tools.name: get_connections
tools.description: Find the next train/bus/tram/boat connections between two Swiss stations or addresses, with platforms, delays, transfers and per-leg details.

tools.name: get_departures
tools.description: Live departure board for a Swiss public transport station, with delays and platforms.

tools.name: get_arrivals
tools.description: Live arrival board for a Swiss public transport station.

tools.name: search_stations
tools.description: Search Swiss public transport stations and stops by name.

tools.name: get_nearby_stations
tools.description: Find public transport stations near a WGS84 point, sorted by distance.

tools.name: get_station_passengers
tools.description: Average daily, weekday and non-working-day passengers (boardings + alightings) at an SBB station, per survey year (newest first). Also canton, infrastructure manager and coordinates.

tools.name: get_station_punctuality
tools.description: Punctuality at a station for the most recent operating day in SBB's actual-data feed (usually yesterday): stops operated, share punctual (delay < 3 min, SBB's definition), delayed and cancelled stops, and the most-delayed arrivals. Covers all operators reporting to the national feed.

tools.name: get_station_accessibility
tools.description: Platforms at an SBB station: platform number, type (island/side), length, usable area, and whether it can be reached step-free without crossing tracks ('rail-free access'). Use for wheelchair, pram or heavy-luggage trip planning; confirm lift status with SBB on the day.

tools.name: get_rail_disruptions
tools.description: Current and recent SBB rail traffic information: interruptions, restrictions and replacement buses, newest first. Optionally filter by a place or line in the text (e.g. 'Gotthard', 'S12', 'Lausanne').

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: MeteoSwiss current conditions, 8-day forecast and active weather warnings for a Swiss postal code (via the MeteoSwiss app service).

tools.name: get_weather_warnings
tools.description: Active MeteoSwiss weather warnings (wind, thunderstorms, heat, snow, flood, forest fire…) for a Swiss postal code, with danger levels 1–5 (via the MeteoSwiss app service).

tools.name: get_current_measurements
tools.description: Live 10-minute measurements from the official MeteoSwiss (SwissMetNet) station network. Choose a parameter and optionally filter to stations near a point (pass both near_lat and near_lon) or by name.

tools.name: get_weather_history
tools.description: Historical measurements from an official SwissMetNet station over a date range (recent weeks), delivered via the api.existenz.ch proxy. Station codes are 3-letter MeteoSwiss codes, e.g. 'SMA' Zürich-Fluntern, 'BER' Bern, 'GVE' Geneva — see get_current_measurements station IDs. Long ranges are downsampled: precipitation and sunshine are summed per bucket (totals preserved), other parameters averaged with min/max.

tools.name: get_pollen
tools.description: Live hourly pollen concentrations from the official MeteoSwiss pollen monitoring network. Choose a taxon (grasses, birch, ash, alder, hazel, mugwort, ambrosia); optionally sort stations by distance from a point (pass both near_lat and near_lon).

tools.name: list_weather_stations
tools.description: List official SwissMetNet stations reporting a given parameter, with coordinates and altitude.

tools.name: list_ogd_stations
tools.description: Stations of the official MeteoSwiss measurement networks (open data): abbreviation, name, canton, altitude, coordinates and start of record. Filter by canton, name, or nearness to a WGS84 point. Use the abbreviation with get_ogd_recent / get_ogd_history.

tools.name: get_ogd_recent
tools.description: Latest official measurements at a MeteoSwiss station (abbreviation like 'BER' or name like 'Bern / Zollikofen'): temperature, humidity, precipitation, wind, sunshine, pressure, snow depth, radiation. 10-minute values (default) or hourly. Returns the newest row plus a short series.

tools.name: get_ogd_history
tools.description: Official historical measurements at a MeteoSwiss station for a date range, at 10-minute (current year only), hourly, daily, monthly or yearly resolution — monthly/yearly series go back to the start of the station's record (often the 1800s). Default parameters: temperature (mean/min/max), humidity, precipitation, wind, sunshine, pressure, snow depth, radiation. At most 400 rows per call; use a coarser granularity for long ranges.

tools.name: get_water_data
tools.description: Latest water level, discharge and temperature for a FOEN hydrology station, by numeric station ID. Do not guess IDs: call list_hydro_stations with a river, lake or place name first and use the station_id it returns.

tools.name: get_water_history
tools.description: Historical water level, discharge or temperature for a FOEN station over a date range (recent weeks). Get the station ID from list_hydro_stations. Long ranges are downsampled to bucket means (with min/max) to stay compact.

tools.name: list_hydro_stations
tools.description: List FOEN river/lake monitoring stations with their IDs and water bodies. Optionally filter by name (river, lake or place).

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Search Swiss addresses, places, municipalities and postal codes and return coordinates (WGS84 + LV95). Works with street addresses ('Bundesplatz 3 Bern'), place names ('Matterhorn'), and PLZ codes.

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Find the nearest registered building/address for WGS84 coordinates using the federal Register of Buildings and Dwellings (GWR). Returns street, number, postal code, locality, municipality and EGID.

tools.name: get_elevation
tools.description: Return the terrain elevation in metres above sea level for WGS84 coordinates in Switzerland.

tools.name: get_elevation_profile
tools.description: Compute a terrain elevation profile along a line of WGS84 points (e.g. a hike). Returns distance/elevation pairs plus total ascent and descent.

tools.name: get_municipality
tools.description: Return the Swiss municipality (Gemeinde) containing the given WGS84 point, including its official BFS number and canton.

tools.name: get_solar_potential
tools.description: Return the federal Sonnendach solar-energy suitability of the roof surface(s) within 5 m of the given WGS84 coordinates, nearest first: suitability class, mean irradiation per m² (kWh/m²/yr), total roof-surface irradiation (kWh/yr), roof area, orientation and slope. Orientation follows the Sonnendach convention: 0° = south, −90° = east, +90° = west, ±180° = north.

tools.name: identify_map_layers
tools.description: Power tool: query any federal geodata layer(s) at a WGS84 point (e.g. 'ch.bafu.laerm-strassenlaerm_tag' for road noise, 'ch.bafu.gefahren-basiskarte' hazards, 'ch.are.bauzonen' building zones). Returns raw attributes per matching feature.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Search the official swissNAMES3D gazetteer for named places of every kind: mountains and peaks, lakes, rivers, passes, valleys, glaciers, localities, huts, cable cars, landmarks. Returns type, canton, municipality and coordinates (WGS84). Use geocode for street addresses.

tools.name: search_map_layers
tools.description: Search the catalogue of ~900 federal geodata layers on geo.admin.ch (noise, natural hazards, building zones, protected areas, radon, groundwater, solar, cadastre…) and return their layer ids for identify_map_layers and find_map_features.

tools.name: find_map_features
tools.description: Search one federal map layer for features whose attribute matches a value (e.g. layer 'ch.bfe.stauanlagen-bundesaufsicht', field 'damname', value 'Dixence'). Call without 'field' to list the layer's searchable fields and sample values.

tools.name: convert_wgs84_to_lv95
tools.description: Convert WGS84 latitude/longitude (Switzerland and surroundings) to Swiss LV95 coordinates (EPSG:2056). Also returns legacy LV03 values.

tools.name: convert_lv95_to_wgs84
tools.description: Convert Swiss LV95 coordinates (EPSG:2056, easting ~2'600'000 / northing ~1'200'000) to WGS84 latitude/longitude. LV03 legacy values (600'000/200'000 range) are auto-detected and shifted. Swapped easting/northing and out-of-range values are rejected with an explanation.

tools.name: lookup_postcode
tools.description: Resolve a 4-digit Swiss postal code (PLZ/NPA) to its locality/localities with coordinates.

tools.name: search_locality
tools.description: Search Swiss localities by name in the official directory and return their postal code(s).

tools.name: track_parcel
tools.description: Generate the official Swiss Post tracking URL for a shipment number (parcels, registered mail). Returns the link — tracking status itself requires the Swiss Post site.

tools.name: list_postcodes_in_canton
tools.description: All postal codes (PLZ/NPA) and localities in a canton from the official locality directory, with the municipality/municipalities each covers, main language and coordinates. Optionally filter to one municipality.

tools.name: get_building
tools.description: Official GWR/RegBL record for a building identified by its federal EGID: status, category, construction year, floors, dwelling count, area, heating info. Get the EGID from reverse_geocode.

tools.name: search_buildings
tools.description: Find buildings in the federal building register by street address (e.g. 'Bundesplatz 3, Bern'). Returns the official address, EGID (federal building id) and coordinates; pass the EGID to get_building for the full record.

tools.name: buildings_near
tools.description: Buildings from the federal building register closest to a WGS84 point (default within 100 m), nearest first: address, EGID, building category and construction year.

tools.name: get_property_price_index
tools.description: Swiss residential property price indices — privately owned apartments, single-family houses and apartment buildings — from the Federal Statistical Office (IMPI, transaction prices) and the private index providers Wüest Partner, IAZI and Fahrländer Partner, quarterly or annual. Returns the series, latest value and year-on-year change.

tools.name: get_rent_index
tools.description: Swiss rent indices for rental housing units, office, retail and industrial/commercial space (Wüest Partner asking rents and other providers, via the SNB data portal), quarterly or annual, with year-on-year change. For the official CPI rent component see search_real_estate_data.

tools.name: search_real_estate_data
tools.description: Search opendata.swiss for housing, rents, construction, vacancy and building datasets (BFS, cantons, cities), e.g. 'Leerwohnungen' (vacant dwellings), 'Mietpreis', 'Bauinvestitionen', 'Wohnungsbestand'. Returns dataset ids for get_dataset / list_dataset_resources.

tools.name: search_federal_law
tools.description: Search the Swiss Classified Compilation (SR/RS) of federal law by title or abbreviation (e.g. 'data protection', 'OR', 'Datenschutz'). Exact abbreviation/title matches are ranked first. Returns SR number, title, abbreviation and the official Fedlex link. Search in the language of your query term (German titles for German terms, etc.).

tools.name: get_law_by_sr
tools.description: Look up one act of the Classified Compilation by its SR number (e.g. '220' Code of Obligations, '235.1' Data Protection Act). Returns titles in all official languages, in-force status and Fedlex links for the act currently in force; other acts sharing the SR number (e.g. repealed predecessors) are listed separately under other_acts.

tools.name: get_population
tools.description: Official permanent resident population (BFS STATPOP) for Switzerland and every canton, latest available year. Optionally filter to one canton by name.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Full-text search over the national open-data catalogue opendata.swiss: statistics (population, prices, energy…), geodata, transport, health and more. Returns dataset IDs for get_dataset.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Full metadata for one opendata.swiss dataset: description, publisher, licence and direct download links for every resource (CSV, JSON, geodata…).

tools.name: list_dataset_resources
tools.description: All downloadable resources and services of one opendata.swiss dataset (CSV, JSON, XLSX, WMS/WFS, APIs…) with format, licence and direct URL. Optionally filter by format, e.g. 'CSV' or 'JSON'.

tools.name: search_parliament_business
tools.description: Search Curia Vista for federal parliamentary business (motions, postulates, interpellations, bills) by title keyword (case-insensitive). Returns business number, type, status and submission date.

tools.name: get_parliament_business
tools.description: Details of a specific Curia Vista business by its numeric ID (e.g. 20230456 → ID from search).

tools.name: get_session_schedule
tools.description: Recent and upcoming sessions of the Federal Assembly with dates and names.

tools.name: get_parliament_votes
tools.description: Formal council votes for a parliamentary business (by short number like '23.4567'), including the subject, what yes/no meant, and the actual yes/no/abstain tallies of the most recent vote.

tools.name: search_council_members
tools.description: Search members of the National Council and Council of States (current by default) by last name (case-insensitive fragment), canton or party abbreviation.

tools.name: search_parliament_speeches
tools.description: Full-text search of speeches (Amtliches Bulletin / debate transcripts) in the federal parliament or a cantonal/municipal parliament. Returns speaker, party, date, an excerpt around the search term, and links to the transcript and video. Filter by speaker name or affair id.

tools.name: get_politician_interests
tools.description: Declared interests and mandates of a member of parliament (board seats, associations, advisory roles), with role, organisation type and whether the mandate is paid. Federal parliament by default; cantonal parliaments where published.

tools.name: search_cantonal_affairs
tools.description: Search motions, postulates, interpellations, questions and bills in the 26 cantonal parliaments (and municipal councils), newest first. Pass a canton to search one parliament, or omit it to search all cantons. For federal business use search_parliament_business.

tools.name: get_parliamentary_documents
tools.description: Official documents (texts, reports, answers, votes material) for a parliamentary affair by its OpenParlData id, or a full-text document search within a parliament. Returns titles, dates, languages and download links.

tools.name: get_committee_meetings
tools.description: Meetings of a parliament's committees or plenary, newest first: date, name, location and links to agenda and documents. Pass a committee name (e.g. 'Finanzkommission', 'Bildung') to list that committee's meetings; omit it for the parliament's latest meetings. Federal committee meetings are not published (confidential) — cantonal and municipal ones often are.

tools.name: list_vote_dates
tools.description: List available federal popular-vote days with official result data (newest first).

tools.name: get_voting_results
tools.description: Official results of federal popular votes for a vote day (default: most recent): national yes-share, turnout, accepted/rejected, cantonal majority, and optional per-canton breakdown.

tools.name: get_emergency_alerts
tools.description: All currently active Alertswiss population warnings for Switzerland: event type, severity, affected regions, official instructions. Optionally filter by a region or canton (code or name in any national language or English, accents optional).

tools.name: get_avalanche_bulletin
tools.description: The current official SLF avalanche bulletin for Switzerland: danger ratings (EAWS scale 1 low – 5 very high) per bulletin, each listing the warning regions it covers, with elevation/time breakdown where published. Outside winter the bulletin is empty and this tool reports that clearly.

tools.name: get_avalanche_danger_at
tools.description: Avalanche danger level for a specific WGS84 point (e.g. a ski-touring destination), resolved against the SLF warning-region polygons.

tools.name: list_avalanche_regions
tools.description: All SLF avalanche warning regions in the current bulletin with their region id and today's danger level (1–5), highest first; optionally filter by a name fragment. Outside the winter season no bulletin — and so no region list — is published.

tools.name: list_snow_stations
tools.description: List SLF IMIS high-alpine measurement stations with code, name, elevation and coordinates. Filter by canton or name, or sort by distance from a point.

tools.name: get_snow_conditions
tools.description: Latest measurement per IMIS station (snow depth, temperatures, wind). Filter by station code (from list_snow_stations) or get the deepest-snow stations right now.

tools.name: get_snow_measurements
tools.description: Detailed last-24-hour series (30-minute values) from one SLF IMIS station: snow depth and its 24 h change, air and snow-surface temperature, snow temperatures at 0/50/100 cm, humidity, wind and reflected shortwave radiation. Station by code (e.g. 'DAV2') or name (e.g. 'Bärentälli').

tools.name: get_trail_closures
tools.description: Current official hiking-trail closures and detours near a WGS84 point. The search covers roughly radius_km (default 20 km, max 100 km) around the point; it is a map-tolerance buffer that may be a square box, so features up to ~1.4× radius_km away can be included, and distances are not computed. There is no nationwide listing. Use before recommending any hike.

tools.name: get_recent_earthquakes
tools.description: The most recent seismic events recorded by the Swiss Seismological Service, newest first. Optionally filter by minimum magnitude. event_type is included only when the service reports it (it may include quarry blasts).

tools.name: get_earthquake_details
tools.description: Full record for one seismic event by its SED event ID — pass the event_id returned by get_recent_earthquakes unchanged (a full 'smi:ch.ethz.sed/…' ID; a short ID is also accepted on a best-effort basis).

tools.name: search_earthquakes
tools.description: Search historical seismic events near a WGS84 point within a radius, with optional date range (inclusive; date_to covers the whole day) and magnitude filter.

tools.name: list_air_quality_stations
tools.description: All stations of the national NABEL air pollution monitoring network with type, altitude, coordinates and a link to each station's live hourly data on the BAFU site (measurement values themselves are not returned). Optionally sorted by distance from a point (pass both near_lat and near_lon).

tools.name: get_air_quality
tools.description: NABEL station details (nearest to a point or by name) together with the Swiss legal ambient limit values (LRV/OAPC) for PM10, PM2.5, NO2, O3, SO2 and CO, plus the link to the station's live hourly measurements. Does NOT return current pollutant concentrations — follow live_data_url for those.

tools.name: get_electricity_tariff
tools.description: Official ElCom electricity tariff for a Swiss municipality, broken into energy, grid usage, community charges and federal grid surcharge (Rp./kWh). Categories: H1–H8 households (H4 = typical 4-room flat), C1–C7 commercial.

tools.name: compare_electricity_tariffs
tools.description: Compare official electricity tariffs (total Rp./kWh, standard product) across up to 10 Swiss municipalities for one category and year. Names that can't be resolved or have no tariff are reported per item in `errors` without failing the comparison.

tools.name: get_ev_chargers_nearby
tools.description: EV charging stations from the national ich-tanke-strom.ch dataset near WGS84 coordinates: operator, plugs, max power, 24h access, address and number of charge points (evse_count) per station. Sorted by distance.

tools.name: search_dams
tools.description: Search the federal dam register by dam, facility or reservoir name (e.g. 'Grande Dixence', 'Sihlsee'), and/or find dams near a WGS84 point. Returns height, type, purpose, reservoir volume and coordinates. Sorted by match quality then height, or by distance when lat/lon are given.

tools.name: get_dams_by_canton
tools.description: All dams under federal supervision located in a canton (code or name in any language, e.g. 'VS', 'Wallis', 'Grisons'). Canton membership is tested against the official cantonal boundary. Sorted by height.

tools.name: get_dam_details
tools.description: Full technical record of one dam: type, purpose, height, crest length and level, reservoir volume, impoundment and storage levels, construction year, operation and supervision dates, coordinates and canton. Look up by exact or partial name, or by the id from search_dams.

tools.name: get_traffic_count
tools.description: Annual traffic figures for ASTRA counting stations matching a name or road (e.g. 'Gotthard', 'Baregg', 'A 1'), or a station number: average daily and weekday traffic, morning/evening peak hours, day/night hourly flow and heavy-goods share.

tools.name: get_traffic_by_canton
tools.description: All ASTRA counting stations on the principal network in a canton, sorted by annual average daily traffic (busiest first). Canton as code or name in any language.

tools.name: get_traffic_nearby
tools.description: ASTRA counting stations near a WGS84 point (default 10 km), closest first, with their annual traffic figures.

tools.name: get_exchange_rate
tools.description: Latest official SNB exchange rate for a currency against CHF (monthly average, e.g. EUR, USD, GBP, JPY). Rates are 'CHF per N units of foreign currency'.

tools.name: get_exchange_rate_history
tools.description: Monthly average CHF exchange-rate history for a currency over a month range (YYYY-MM).

tools.name: list_currencies
tools.description: List all currencies for which the SNB publishes official CHF exchange rates.

tools.name: get_public_holidays
tools.description: Public holidays in Switzerland for a year, optionally scoped to a canton (two-letter code). Includes nationwide and cantonal holidays.

tools.name: get_school_holidays
tools.description: School holiday periods for a Swiss canton and year.

tools.name: is_holiday_today
tools.description: Check whether today (Swiss local date) or a given date is a public holiday in a canton, or — without a canton — whether it is a nationwide public holiday (cantonal-only holidays are listed separately and do not count).

tools.name: get_waste_collection
tools.description: Upcoming waste and recycling collection dates for a Zürich-region ZIP code. Types: waste (household), cardboard, paper, organic (green), special, textile, metal, cargotram, etram, glass.

tools.name: list_waste_types
tools.description: All waste/recycling collection types supported by the waste calendar.

tools.name: get_waste_calendar
tools.description: Full collection calendar for the coming weeks, grouped by day, with a per-type summary (next date and number of collections). Zürich, Winterthur and Uster: pass a ZIP code. Basel-Stadt: pass region 'basel' and the collection area letter (see the city's waste plan).

tools.name: get_swiss_news
tools.description: Latest Swiss news headlines from SRF with links and publication times. Optionally filter by keyword. Returns titles, links and dates only — no summaries or article text (these stay at the source, per licence).

tools.name: search_swiss_news
tools.description: Search current SRF headlines across all categories (Switzerland, international, economy, sport, latest) for keywords; every word must appear in the headline. Returns de-duplicated titles, links, dates and the category they came from — metadata only, per licence.

tools.name: query_lindas
tools.description: Run a read-only SPARQL SELECT query against lindas.admin.ch, the Swiss federal linked-data service. Useful graphs include <https://lindas.admin.ch/elcom/electricityprice> (energy prices), ELI legislation, the municipality register (ld.admin.ch/municipality/{BFS}), and cube.link statistical cubes. A top-level LIMIT of 100 is added if none is given and larger limits are clamped to 200; SERVICE (federation) and update operations are rejected; max 10000 characters.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: The machine-readable register of every data source behind the active Swissyphus modules: operator, licence, attribution string, update frequency, cache TTL and caveats (RFP-grade source governance).

tools.name: check_source_health
tools.description: Ping every upstream Swiss data source behind the active modules and report status and latency — Swissyphus's built-in status page. Use when another tool reports a source as unavailable.

tools.name: about_swissyphus
tools.description: Orientation for agents: lists the active modules, what each covers, and example questions each can answer. Call this first if unsure which tool fits a Swiss data question.

preset.title: Module preset
preset.description: Which bundle of tools to load. One of: minimal, commuter, outdoor, business, citizen, legal, compliance, full. 'full' loads every module; the smaller presets save context window.
